title: HTML document skeleton
goal: writes HTML documents with language, character encoding, and tab titles.
summary: The doctype tells the browser to render in standards mode. The head stores page information, and the body stores the content displayed on the page.
tasks: Add the lang attribute to <html> with the value en.
Use meta in <head> to declare UTF-8 character encoding, and use title to set the tab title to "Community Book Corner".
Write "Open Saturday afternoon." in an existing paragraph within <body>.
hint: tab title is placed in the title of the head. The opening time is written in the p of the body, so readers can see it directly on the page.

example.code: The north gate opens at 8:00.
example.note: Park map uses lang="en" to declare that the text is in English. After opening the page, the tab page displays the Park map, and the page displays the opening hours.
